With m=(α+D)/β, η=2D/(α+D)∈(0,2), w=z0/m>0, q=r/(2β), the exact normalized variance is F=2η(1+wq)/[(q+1)(q+2)]+(w−1)²q/[(q+1)²(q+2)]. Independent exact symbolic differentiation gives Fprime=2(A−Bq−Cq²−ηwq³)/[(q+1)³(q+2)²], A=(w−1)²+η(2w−3), B=(w−1)²+η(5−2w)>0, C=(w−1)²+η(w+2)>0. Thus A<=0 strictly decreasing for q>0, while A>0 gives one global maximum at unique positive polynomial root. A=(w−w−)(w−w+) with w±=1−η ±sqrt(η(1+η)); w−>0 iff η<1/3 iff α>5D. The two overshoot wings are w>w+ and w<w− when permitted. Implicit-function near each positive critical w_c gives q*=A/B_c+O(A²), gain=A²/(4B_c)+O(A³), B_c>0. Exact CIR moment recursion applies even near α<D when reflecting/canonical nonabsorbing radial boundary specified; no empirical extrapolation.
